mapper.insert: insert into lx_homework_submission (id, assignment_id, student_id, student_name, content, file_address, submit_time, status, create_id, create_time, state, version) values( #{id}, #{assignmentId}, #{studentId}, #{studentName}, #{content}, #{fileAddress}, #{submitTime}, #{status}, #{createId}, #{createTime}, #{state}, #{version} )
mapper.update: update lx_homework_submission set grade = #{grade}, feedback = #{feedback}, graded_time = #{gradedTime}, graded_by = #{gradedBy}, status = 'graded', update_id = #{updateId}, update_time = #{updateTime}, version = version + 1 where id = #{id} and version = #{version}
mapper.select: select * from lx_homework_submission where id = #{id} and state = '1'
